_about: Which files make up the library. "regions" lists the body-region files; each names the defaults its moves inherit (region, group, order, camera, equipment, sources) and lists the move ids it holds, in order. Every move is its own file at moves/<id>.json, so one exercise can be written back without touching any other. "about" is the field guide every move file is written against. "code" lists hand-written moves (JavaScript under client/coach/library/), for anything the data format cannot say — empty today: every move is data.
